prior_primary.short_quote: Among putative sunitinib targets, only RET was expressed and activated in analysed samples.
prior_primary.scope: Limited transcriptome, IHC and biochemical analyses, with specimen denominator/sites/assay details unavailable in abstract.10 progressive metastatic translocated EMC patients treated; antecedent2-case source must not be pooled as12 independent patients.

material_correction: The original frozen rationale described RET expression without explicitly retaining published RET activation. Generic measured RET activation beyond RNA is already prior art and cannot be the discovery. Full2014 assay/case detail remains unavailable, so named site absence must not be assumed.
distinct_conditional_endpoint: Only a new source-authenticated full-condition, fixed-comparator direct RET phosphosite/total-protein pattern with informative unfavorable controls, donor/batch mapping and assay-specific uncertainty might add useful evidence. The existing sites/controls stay fixed. Higher phosphorylation is not calibrated site occupancy, receptor dependency or clinical benefit.
source_authentication_status: New1998-tumor source has no authenticated EMC roster or processed measurement link established; no numerical EMC outcome inspected. Pending useful source/novelty evidence blocks promotion.
defeat: Already-published generic RET activation, unknown complete prior assays, unavailable new source identity/direct-site/total linkage or uninterpretable comparator pattern -> no new finding. No alternative kinase search after values.
